product_one_liner.value: Rasayel is a WhatsApp customer-communication platform for B2B sales and support teams that combines a shared inbox, automated follow-ups, AI chatbots and CRM integrations.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 17 employees; the company profile reports 15.

hq_location.notes: CB Insights identifies Myrtle Point, Oregon. Rasayel operates remotely; other databases give conflicting locations, including Alberta and Dubai.

founded_year.notes: The investor portfolio and company profile give 2022; PitchBook instead gives 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog covers WhatsApp sales, product guidance and marketing; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored product-architecture or infrastructure posts was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable jobs page explicitly states that Rasayel has no job openings. An older Senior Software Engineer listing is not an AI/ML/data-science title; the third-party board may lag hiring activity.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Support AI documentation, AI product/blog material, security and privacy policies, and searched for a subprocessor register; no underlying model or provider was publicly identified.

compliance_certs.notes: No certification among the five requested is claimed for Rasayel on these policies. GDPR legal-basis and rights language is not a certification; the PCI Level 1 statement concerns Stripe, not Rasayel.

last_funding.notes: Preqin explicitly associates the October 2026 $10 million Wamda Capital round with rasayel.io. A dated funding roundup corroborates the amount and month, although it prints rasayel.com. PitchBook still lists the earlier February 2022 seed round; no primary financing announcement was located.

raised_18mo.notes: The dated roundup reports October 5, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; Preqin independently identifies the rasayel.io business and October 2026 round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable jobs page says no openings; the historical Founding Sales Executive posting is closed. The third-party jobs page may lag hiring activity.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated changelog feature entry is April 28, 2026, before the May 9–November 9, 2026 window. Current Cleo homepage messaging is undated; its introduction blog post is dated April 14, 2025.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page lists only CEO/co-founder Tarek Khalil and COO/co-founder Mohamed Elbadwihi as C-level leaders, and no VPs. Their current roles began in March 2024, before November 9, 2025; no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly documented integrations, not proof that Rasayel uses all five internally.
